sara (cs): Quick alert 1 EU onboarding tenants show stalled embedding indexing after last night's backfill. ClearPath's demo is blocked. Need customer-friendly status + RCA + offer.
amanda (cs lead): Short & non-technical please. Also include ETA and compensation.
jon (eng): RCA (short): a recent change removed an internal safety throttle which let the reindex spawn too many concurrent shard workers. One EU node hit transient disk pressure and retries created a backlog. Action taken: paused the backfill, cleared the affected node, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. ETA ~12-18 hours. If customer needs demo-ready sooner we can run a targeted expedited reindex (~1-2 hours) on request.
mike (ops): Paused at 02:15 UTC, resumed rate-limited at 05:00 UTC (~30% throughput). Backfill progressing at ~35% of normal; projected finish for affected tenants ~12-18h. Targeted warm-path available if CS approves.
amanda (cs lead): Draft customer note to send: "Hi <Customer>, quick update: during a scheduled reindex a safety throttle was unintentionally removed which caused retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We've paused the job, addressed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill. We expect completion within ~12-18 hours. If you need demo-ready sooner, reply and we can run an expedited reindex (~1-2h) and will cover the cost for trial accounts. As an apology we've applied one week of Dedicated credits to your account. 1 Amanda, CS"
sara (cs): Good. Amanda, send to ClearPath + affected onboarders and cc me + eng. Update customer-health dashboard: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=12-18h, Credit=1 week, Owner=amanda.
